glue.description: persist the last accepted bundle revision on the agent host and refuse a bundle with a lower revision before opa loads it

notes: opa run --server -b <bundle> --verification-key pub.pem (RS256 signed bundles, documented bundle signing). Observed: process alive=True, policy loaded and serving=True. OPA verifies the bundle signature at the agent (the enforcement point) but keeps no monotonic revision floor: an older signed revision loads and serves. A wrapper persisting the last accepted .manifest revision and refusing lower ones is glue without a new anchor. (bundle_results.json).
